title: Challenges in Multimodal Scientific Claim Verification Using Simplified Visual Data

contributions.purpose: 用玩具数据模拟科学声明验证
contributions.mechanism: MNIST 数字图配算术/范围声明(如"数字之和为偶"),CNN 视觉编码+冻结 BERL 文本编码拼接分类
contributions.evaluation: MNIST 验证准确率约 85% 饱和(30 epoch 后过拟合)
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a novel approach using the MNIST dataset to simulate simplified scientific claim verification tasks.

contributions.purpose: 揭示当前多模态架构结构化推理的局限
contributions.mechanism: 跨域迁移(Fashion-MNIST/SVHN)、输入置换、对抗声明测试
contributions.evaluation: 迁移到 Fashion-MNIST/SVHN 显著下降;对抗声明降至近随机;置换输入 SVHN 退化(定性,仅图无表)
contributions.source_quote: Our findings highlight significant challenges in training models that can reliably perform such verification tasks, underscoring the limitations of current multimodal architectures in structured reasoning scenarios.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work differs from previous studies by focusing on controlled, low-level visual reasoning tasks using datasets like MNIST (LeCun et al., 1998b) to simulate claim validation scenarios.

notes: 纯负结果玩具论文:用 MNIST 冒充"科学声明验证"外部效度存疑(simulated proxy)。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳(2 条)。数据红旗:全文仅图 1-5、无任何数值表格,唯一数字"约 85%"来自正文口述,无误差棒、无统计显著性、无计算资源(checklist 自认 No)。与 AS0202 疑似同作者孪生投稿——同一 MNIST 数据/同结论,AS0202 把本文负结果重新包装成 benchmark。质量低,reject。
